note: Standing memory of tracked threads. The morning run appends to log (newest last), sets status, and never deletes entries. Citations [n] in t refer to the edition that added the entry; the same sources are copied into src so links keep working.

log.t: France 11–12 Oct, then seven countries 1–2 Nov including a SE distribution centre. Belgian criminal case open. [2, 45]
src: Suspected cyberattacks trigger supermarket fridge failures across Europe

log.t: Wave widened to Italy and Romania; nine countries on the night of 1–2 Nov. Italy's prime minister's office meets intelligence chiefs on 3 Nov; the Pentagon's DCIS is probing August commissary outages. [3, 4, 7]

log.t: Germany (Reisbach, Wuppertal, Raesfeld) and Portugal (seven Intermarché stores) added, at least 11 countries since 1 Nov. EU Commissioner Hansen calls it a deliberate attempt to disrupt the food supply; US officials privately suspect Iran-linked hackers for the commissary hits. [35, 36, 37, 42, 43]
